query:
UPDATE mdm_party_roles
        SET starts_at = $4,
            ends_at = $5,
            status = COALESCE($6, status),
            comments = COALESCE($7, comments),
            attributes_json = COALESCE($8, attributes_json),
            updated_by = $9,
            updated_at = now()
        WHERE id = $1 AND tenant_id = $2 AND party_id = $3 AND deleted_at IS NULL
